threads.body: The custom dependency will not be updated with the Gradle semconv dependency as intended. The existing package rule at `.github/renovate.json5:35-46` groups every `custom.regex` update into the `weekly update` branch, while the Gradle-managed `io.opentelemetry.semconv:opentelemetry-semconv` update is excluded from that group. Renovate will therefore open separate PRs—one changing this manifest and one changing the library version—and each will fail the new equality test. Add a later package rule for this dependency that assigns both the Gradle and custom-regex records to the same group/branch.

On Windows, converting the file URI with `URI#getPath()` produces a path such as `/C:/...`, which `JarFile(String)` does not interpret as the original drive path. Convert the URI directly to a `Path` and pass its `File` form so this test remains platform-independent.
